name: Alexav SpeedUp M1
summary: Alexav SpeedUp M1 is a scalping Expert Advisor designed for the M1 (1-minute) timeframe that aims to capture small price movements using momentum-based entry signals. The EA likely uses a combination of moving average speed/acceleration and price action to identify rapid short-term trend shifts for quick entries and exits. It is optimized for high-frequency trading on low timeframes with tight take-profit targets.
summary_zh: Alexav SpeedUp M1是一个专为M1（1分钟）时间框架设计的剥头皮智能交易系统，旨在利用基于动量的入场信号捕捉小幅价格波动。该EA可能结合均线速度/加速度和价格行为来识别快速的短期趋势转折，实现快速进出。它针对低时间框架的高频交易进行了优化，止损目标较紧。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于价格加速（SpeedUp）的剥头皮交易，专注于M1时间框架上的快速价格动量变化。入场条件可能依赖于均线斜率变化或价格加速度指标，当检测到上行动量加速时做多，下行动量加速时做空。出场条件通常采用较小的固定止盈点数和止损点数，追求高胜率小盈利的交易模式。仓位管理方面，该EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单比例计算方式。资金管理方面，由于是M1剥头皮策略，缺少点差过滤机制是一个显著风险，在高点差时段可能导致频繁亏损。整体策略缺乏多时间框架确认，容易在震荡行情中产生大量虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is based on price acceleration (SpeedUp) scalping, focusing on rapid price momentum changes on the M1 timeframe. Entry conditions likely rely on moving average slope changes or price acceleration indicators, going long when upward momentum acceleration is detected and going short when downward momentum acceleration is detected. Exit conditions typically use small fixed take-profit and stop-loss pip values, pursuing a high win-rate, small-profit-per-trade model. Position sizing likely employs fixed lot sizes or a simple proportional calculation based on account balance. Money management is a concern as the M1 scalping strategy lacks a spread filter mechanism, which is a significant risk that can cause frequent losses during high-spread periods. The overall strategy lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, making it prone to generating numerous false signals in ranging markets that lead to consecutive losses.

策略逻辑简单直观，基于动量加速概念易于理解
固定止盈止损使每笔交易的风险收益比明确可控
pros_en: High trading frequency on M1 timeframe generates many trading opportunities in a short time
Simple and intuitive strategy logic based on momentum acceleration concept is easy to understand
Fixed take-profit and stop-loss make the risk-reward ratio of each trade clearly controllable
cons: M1剥头皮策略对点差极度敏感，高点差环境下极易亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认，在震荡行情中容易产生大量虚假信号
固定手数仓位管理无法根据市场波动率动态调整风险敞口
缺少新K线检查机制可能导致同一根K线内重复开仓
cons_en: M1 scalping strategy is extremely sensitive to spreads and easily loses money in high-spread environments
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, prone to generating numerous false signals in ranging markets
Fixed lot position sizing cannot dynamically adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Absence of new bar check mechanism may cause repeated position opening within the same bar
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，在点差超过阈值时暂停交易以保护资金
引入更高时间框架趋势确认，避免逆势剥头皮交易
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold to protect capital
Introduce higher timeframe trend confirmation to avoid counter-trend scalping trades

risk_points_en: M1 timeframe scalping generates many losing trades during high-spread periods (e.g., thin Asian session)
Lack of new bar check may cause tick-level repeated position opening, leading to overexposure risk
